EC1: The use of beta blockers within 2 months of randomization
EC2: Patients actively listed for transplantation [OR] at time of entry into the study or anticipated to undergo heart transplantation [OR], interventional catheterization [OR], or corrective cardiac surgery during the 7 months following entry into the study
EC3: Sustained [OR] or symptomatic ventricular dysrhythmias [OR] uncontrolled by [OR] drug therapy or the use of an implantable defibrillator, and/or significant cardiac conduction defects, e.g., 2nd degree [OR] or 3rd degree AV block [OR], or sick sinus syndrome [AND], [NOT] unless a functioning pacemaker is in place
EC4: Uncorrected obstructive [OR] or severe regurgitant valve disease [OR], nondilated cardiomyopathy [OR], or significant systemic ventricular outflow obstruction
EC5: Known renovascular hypertension [OR] or evidence of pulmonary hypertension (pulmonary vascular resistance > 6 Wood units) unresponsive to vasodilator agents such as oxygen [OR], nitroprusside [OR], or nitric oxide
EC6: History [OR] or current clinical evidence of moderate-to-severe fixed obstructive pulmonary disease [OR] or severe reactive airway diseases (e.g., asthma) requiring hospitalization [OR] within the past 2 years or patient currently using long-term inhaled bronchodilators
EC7: Renal [OR], hepatic [OR], gastrointestinal [OR], or biliary disorder that could impair absorption, metabolism or excretion [AND] of orally administered medication
EC8: Concurrent terminal illness [OR] or other severe disease [OR] (e.g., active neoplasm) or other significant laboratory value(s) which, in the opinion of the investigator, could preclude participation or survival
EC9: Endocrine disorders such as primary aldosteronism [OR], pheochromocytoma [OR], hyper [OR]- or hypothyroidism [OR], insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus
EC10: Unwillingness [OR] or inability [OR] to cooperate [OR], or for the parents or guardians to give consent, or for the child to give assent, or any condition of sufficient severity to impair cooperation in the study
EC11: Pregnancy [OR] or possible pregnancy [OR] at time of randomization, or female of child bearing potential who are lactating [OR], or sexually active and [NOT] not taking adequate contraceptive precautions (e.g., intrauterine device [OR] or oral contraceptives for 3 months prior to entry into the study)
EC12: Use of an investigational drug within 30 days of randomization [OR], or within 5 half-lives of the investigational drug (the longer period will apply)
EC13: History of drug sensitivity [OR] or allergic reaction to alpha-blockers [OR] or beta-blockers
EC14: Use of any of the following medications within two weeks of randomization: MAO inhibitors [OR], Calcium channel blockers [OR], alpha blockers [OR], beta blockers [OR], disopyramide [OR], flecainide [OR], encainide [OR], moricizine [OR], propafenone [OR], sotalol [OR], or beta adrenergic agonists
EC15: Hospital admission for protein losing enteropathy [OR] or plastic bronchitis within 3 months of randomization
EC16: Active [OR] and/or chronic protein losing enteropathy [OR] or plastic bronchitis [AND] (on inhaled medication to control the plastic bronchitis).
EC18: Renal dysfunction [AND] defined as serum creatinine >2.0mg/dL
EC19: Hepatic dysfunction defined as serum AST [OR] and/or ALT> 3 times upper limit of normal (approximately 120 IU/L however, will vary depending on age),
EC20: Significant anemia [OR] or polycythemia defined as hemoglobin [OR] >18gm/dL or hemoglobin <7gm/dL
EC21: Severely elevated serum BNP defined as BNP>300pg/ml
